content: उद्भास् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> To shine. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To light up, illuminate, render beautiful, decorate; ornament; उद्भासितं मङ्गलसंविधाभिः <ls>R. 7. 16</ls>; काले घनोद्भासिते <ls>Mk. 5. 35</ls>. .²2 (<ab>fig.</ab>) To bring into prominence, elevate, exalt; उद्भासिताखिलखलस्य <ls>Bh. 2. 59</ls>.
